name: Space Monkey
tagline: Turns any rocket launch into a dark mission-brief web card
description: Ask about a specific spaceflight and it assembles the whole story, whether that mission flew, is still on the manifest, was called off, or ended in loss. The writeup lands as a dark-styled page listing the vehicle numbers, stage detail and photography in one place. Good preparation before a webcast.
author: monomyth
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
